title: Get Copilot Features Before Everyone Else (Frontier Program Explained)
description:
Microsoft is rolling out new Copilot features constantly, but some users are getting access weeks or even months before everyone else.

In this video, I show you how Microsoft Frontier works, how to enable it in your Microsoft 365 tenant, and how to control which users get access to prerelease Copilot features. If you want to test new AI capabilities before they reach general availability, this is the setting you need to know about.

🚀 What You'll Learn:
What Microsoft Frontier is
How to get early access to new Copilot features
How to enable Frontier in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center
How to scope early access to specific users or groups
Why some Frontier features may take time to appear
How Microsoft agents interact with Frontier access
Why IT teams and MSPs should create a dedicated pilot group

💡 Why Watch?
Frontier gives IT teams and MSPs a chance to test new Copilot capabilities before users start asking about them. Instead of reacting to Microsoft releases after they hit production, you can preview features, build documentation, test workflows, and prepare your users ahead of time.

👍 Engage with Me:
If you found this video helpful, hit Like, subscribe, and share it with someone managing Microsoft Copilot.

I'd also love to hear from you. What new Copilot feature do you want me to test next through Microsoft Frontier?
